source_questions.question: Which of the following options best describes you today? For the purpose of this survey, a developer is "someone who writes code". *
Which of the following best describes the highest level of formal education that you’ve completed? *
NOT including education, how many years have you coded professionally (as a part of your work)?
Which of the following describes your current job, the one you do most of the time? Please select only one.
Where do you live? *

Which programming, scripting, and markup languages have you done extensive development work in over the past year, and which do you want to work in over the next year? (If you both worked with the language and want to continue to do so, please check both boxes in that row.)
Do you currently use AI tools in your development process? *
For the AI tools you use as part of your development workflow, what are the MOST important benefits you are hoping to achieve? Please check all that apply.
How much do you trust the accuracy of the output from AI tools as part of your development workflow?

Are you someone who writes code? Please select one of the following options that best describes you today.
Which of the following best describes the highest level of formal education that you’ve completed?
How many years of professional work experience do you have? Please round to the nearest whole number, excluding any decimal points.  If your answer is '0', please leave blank.
Which of the following describes your current job or the job you had for the most time in the past year?
Where do you live?

Did you work with programming, scripting and markup languages in the last year or do you plan to in the year to come?  Here, we are referring to anything you use that is conventionally referred to as code.

Which programming, scripting, and markup languages have you done extensive development work in over the past year, and which do you want to work in over the next year? (If you both worked with the language and want to continue to do so, please check both boxes in that row.)
Do you currently use AI tools in your development process?
How much do you trust the accuracy of the output from AI tools as part of your development workflow?

notes: 2025 WorkExp measures professional work, not professional coding. Blank includes zero per the questionnaire; do not infer zero.
2024 YearsCodePro excludes education; Less than 1 year maps to 0.5 for binning only; More than 50 years maps to a lower-bound 51.
The 2023 trust question is AIBen. AIAcc in 2023 measures hoped-for benefits.
Primary DevType is single-choice in both cohort instruments. A defensive Multiple roles group preserves an unexpected multiselect without duplication.
Education labels shorten original text; raw answers, including any upstream encoding damage, are retained.
NA/empty map to null. Experience outside [0,80] is unreported for binning and counted separately; raw text is retained.
